items.translation: 原子性地返回并移除存储在 `sourceKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `from` 参数是 head/tail），并将存储在 `destinationKey` 中的列表的第一个/最后一个元素（取决于 `to` 参数是 head/tail）推入该列表。

items.source: Increment value of a hash field by the given delta.
items.translation: 将哈希的 field 字段值按给定的 delta 进行增量更新。

items.source: Read records from one or more StreamOffsets.
items.translation: 从一条或多条StreamOffset中读取记录。

items.source: Read records from one or more StreamOffsets using a consumer group.
items.translation: 使用消费者组从一条或多条StreamOffset中读取记录。

items.source:
Atomically transfer a key from a source Redis instance to a destination Redis instance. On success the key is
deleted from the original instance and is guaranteed to exist in the target instance.
items.translation: 原子地将键从源 Redis 实例传输到目标 Redis 实例。若操作成功，该键将从原始实例中删除，并保证存在于目标实例中。

items.source: a list of Long values for each of the fields provided: 2 indicating the specific field is deleted already due to expiration, or provided expiry interval is 0; 1 indicating expiration time is set/updated; 0 indicating the expiration time is not set (a provided NX | XX | GT | LT condition is not met); -2 indicating there is no such field; null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 为每个提供的字段列出Long值：2表示该特定字段已因过期而被删除，或提供的过期间隔为 0；1表示设置了/更新了过期时间；0表示未设置过期时间（提供的 NX | XX | GT | LT 条件未满足）；-2表示不存在该字段；在管道/事务中使用时为 null。

items.source: a list of Long values for each of the fields provided: 2 indicating the specific field is deleted already due to expiration, or provided expiry interval is in the past; 1 indicating expiration time is set/updated; 0 indicating the expiration time is not set; -2 indicating there is no such field; null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 为每个提供的字段生成一个Long值列表：2表示该特定字段已因过期而被删除，或提供的过期时间间隔已过；1表示设置了/更新了过期时间；0表示未设置过期时间；-2表示不存在该字段；在管道/事务中使用时为 null。

items.source: a list of Long values for each of the fields provided: 2 indicating the specific field is deleted already due to expiration, or provided expiry interval is in the past; 1 indicating expiration time is set/updated; 0 indicating the expiration time is not set (a provided NX | XX | GT | LT condition is not met); -2 indicating there is no such field; null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 为每个提供的字段生成一个Long值列表：2表示该特定字段已因过期而被删除，或提供的过期时间间隔已过；1表示已设置/更新过期时间；0表示未设置过期时间（提供的 NX | XX | GT | LT 条件未满足）；-2表示不存在该字段；在管道/事务中使用时为 null。

items.source: expiration - must not be null. Use Expiration.persistent() to not set any ttl or Expiration.keepTtl() to keep the existing expiration.
items.translation: expiration - 不能为 null。请使用Expiration.persistent()来不设置任何 TTL，或使用Expiration.keepTtl()来保留现有的过期时间。

items.source: options - the RedisStreamCommands.XDelOptions specifying deletion policy. Use RedisStreamCommands.XDelOptions.defaults() ()} for default behavior.
items.translation: options - 指定删除策略的RedisStreamCommands.XDelOptions。使用RedisStreamCommands.XDelOptions.defaults()获取默认行为。

items.source: count - if the provided count argument is positive, return a list of distinct fields, capped either at count or the set size. If count is negative, the behavior changes and the command is allowed to return the same value multiple times. In this case, the number of returned values is the absolute value of the specified count.
items.translation: count - 如果提供的 count 参数为正数，则返回一个去重字段列表，数量上限为 count 或集合大小中的较小值。如果 count 为负数，行为将发生变化，命令允许返回重复的值；此时，返回值的数量等于指定 count 的绝对值。

items.source: args - must not be null use RedisZSetCommands.ZAddArgs.empty() instead.
empty List when no element could be popped and the timeout was reached. null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 在无法弹出元素且超时时返回空 List；若在管道或事务中使用，则返回 null。

items.source: empty List if key does not exist. null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 不存在时返回空 List。在管道/事务中使用时为 null。

items.source: group - the name of the consumer group.
newOwner - the name of the new consumer.
recordIds - the id's of the records to remove.
groupName - name of the consumer group to create.
items.translation: groupName - 要创建的消费者组名称。

items.source: key - the key the stream is stored at. Must not be null.
items.translation: key - 流存储的键。不能为 null。

items.source: groupName - the name of the consumer group. Must not be null.
items.translation: groupName - 消费者组的名称，不能为 null。

items.source: seconds - the amount of time after which the fields will be expired in seconds, must not be null.
items.translation: seconds - 字段将在多少秒后过期，该值不能为 null。

items.source: millis - the amount of time after which the fields will be expired in milliseconds, must not be null.
items.translation: millis - 字段将在多少毫秒后过期，该值不能为 null。

items.source: unixTime - the moment in time in which the field expires, must not be null.
items.translation: unixTime - 字段过期时刻，不得为 null。

items.source: unixTimeInMillis - the moment in time in which the field expires in milliseconds, must not be null.
items.translation: unixTimeInMillis - 字段过期时刻（以毫秒为单位），不得为 null。
expiration - 要应用的可选过期时间。

items.source: ok if successful. null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 如果成功则返回 ok，在管道/事务中使用则为 null。

items.translation: 成功时返回 true；在管道/事务中使用时无效（返回 null）。

items.translation: 可以为空。在管道/事务中使用时为 null。

items.source: IMPORTANT: The KEYS command is non-interruptible and scans the entire keyspace which may cause performance issues. Consider RedisKeyCommands.scan(ScanOptions) for large datasets.
items.translation: 重要提示： KEYS 命令不可中断，且会扫描整个键空间，这可能导致性能问题。对于大型数据集，请考虑使用 RedisKeyCommands.scan(ScanOptions)。

items.source: Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation: 阻塞连接，直到元素可用或达到timeout。

items.source:
XDELEX is an extension of the Redis Streams XDEL command that provides more control over how message entries
are deleted concerning consumer groups.
items.translation: XDELEX 是 Redis Streams XDEL 命令的扩展，它提供了对消息条目删除方式的更多控制，特别是在涉及消费者组时。

items.source:
XACKDEL combines the functionality of XACK and XDEL in Redis Streams. It acknowledges the specified entry IDs in the
given consumer group and simultaneously attempts to delete the corresponding entries from the stream.
items.translation: XACKDEL 结合了 Redis Streams 中 XACK 和 XDEL 的功能。它会在指定的消费者组中确认给定的条目 ID，并尝试同时从流中删除相应的条目。

items.source:
Retrieve a limited number of records within a specific Range from the stream stored at key.
Use Range.unbounded() to read from the minimum and the maximum ID possible.
Use Limit.unlimited() to read all records.
items.translation:
从存储在该键的流中检索特定范围内的记录的有限数量。
使用Range.unbounded()从最小和最大可能的 ID 处读取。
使用Limit.unlimited()读取所有记录。

items.source: DefaultedRedisConnection provides method delegates to Redis*Command interfaces accessible via RedisConnection. This allows us to maintain backwards compatibility while moving the actual implementation and stay in sync with ReactiveRedisConnection. Going forward the RedisCommands extension is likely to be removed from RedisConnection.
items.translation: DefaultedRedisConnection 提供了对可通过 RedisConnection 访问的 Redis*Command 接口的委托方法。这使得我们能够在迁移实际实现的同时保持向后兼容性，并与 ReactiveRedisConnection 保持同步。今后，RedisCommands 扩展很可能会从 RedisConnection 中移除。

items.source:
Retrieve all records within a specific Range from the stream stored at key.
Use Range.unbounded() to read from the minimum and the maximum ID possible.
items.translation:
从指定键存储的流中检索特定 records 范围内的所有记录。
使用 Range.unbounded() 来读取最小和最大可能的 ID。

items.source: Get set of Tuples in range from Limit#offset to Limit#offset + Limit#count where score is between Range#min and Range#max from sorted set.
items.translation: 获取有序集中分数介于Range#min和Range#max之间，且范围从Limit#offset到Limit#offset + Limit#count的Tuple集合。

items.source: Get set of Tuple in range from Limit#offset to Limit#count where score is between Range#min and Range#max from sorted set ordered high -> low.
items.translation: 获取范围从 `Limit#offset` 到 `Limit#count` 的 `Tuple` 集合，其中分数位于有序集的高 -> 低排序中 `Range#min` 和 `Range#max` 之间。

items.source:
Remove the last element from list at srcKey, append it to dstKey and return its value.
Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation:
从 `srcKey` 对应的列表中移除最后一个元素，将其追加到 `dstKey` 并返回其值。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到 `timeout`。

items.source: Add value to a sorted set at key, or update its score depending on the given args.
items.translation: 向有序集合key添加成员value，或者根据给定的args更新其score。

items.source: Add tuples to a sorted set at key, or update its score depending on the given args.
items.translation: 向已排序集合key添加tuples，或根据给定的args更新其score。

items.source: Returns the length of the value associated with field in the hash stored at key. If the key or the field do not exist, 0 is returned.
items.translation: 返回存储在哈希表key中与field关联的值长度。如果key或field不存在，则返回0。

items.source: Query the members of a geo set which are within the borders of the area specified by a given shape and store the result at destKey. The query's center point is provided by GeoReference.
items.translation: 查询地理集合中位于由给定shape指定的区域边界内的成员，并将结果存储到destKey。查询的中心点由GeoReference提供。

items.source: Create key using the serializedValue, previously obtained using RedisKeyCommands.dump(byte[]).
items.translation: 使用之前通过RedisKeyCommands.dump(byte[])获取的serializedValue创建key。

items.source: Set value for key applying timeouts from expiration if set and inserting/updating values depending on option.
items.translation: 为key设置value，若已设置则应用来自expiration的超时时间，并根据option插入或更新值。

items.source: Return the position of the first bit set to given bit in a string. Range start and end can contain negative values in order to index bytes starting from the end of the string, where -1 is the last byte, -2 is the penultimate.
items.translation: 返回给定 `bit` 在字符串中第一个被置位的位的位置。Range 的起始和结束值可以包含负数，以便从字符串末尾开始索引字节，其中 -1 表示最后一个字节，-2 表示倒数第二个字节。

items.source: Append the given record to the stream stored at Record#getStream. If you prefer manual id assignment over server generated ones make sure to provide an id via Record#withId.
items.translation: 将给定的record追加到存储在Record#getStream的流中。如果您更喜欢手动分配 ID 而非使用服务器生成的 ID，请确保通过Record#withId提供 ID。

items.source: Obtain detailed information about pending messages applying given options.
items.translation: 获取有关待处理的messages的详细信息，应用给定的options。

items.source: Read records from a stream within a specific Range applying a Limit in reverse order.
items.translation: 从流中读取记录，在指定的Range内应用反向Limit。

items.source:
Removes and returns first element from lists stored at keys.
Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation:
从存储在 `keys` 的列表中移除并返回第一个元素。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到 `timeout`。

items.source:
Removes and returns last element from lists stored at keys.
Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation:
从存储在 `keys` 的列表中移除并返回最后一个元素。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到 `timeout`。

items.source:
Remove and return the value with its score having the lowest score from sorted set at key.
Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation:
从有序集合key中移除并返回具有最低分数的元素及其分数。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到timeout。

items.source:
Remove and return the value with its score having the highest score from sorted set at key.
Blocks connection until element available or timeout reached.
items.translation:
从指定 key 的有序集中移除并返回得分最高的元素及其分数。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到timeout超时时间。

items.source: Get set of Tuples between start and end from sorted set.
items.translation: 从有序集中获取介于start和end之间的Tuple集合。

items.source: Get all the elements in Range from the sorted set at key in lexicographical ordering. Result is limited via RedisZSetCommands.Limit.
items.translation: 从指定键的有序集中获取按字典序排列的Range中的所有元素。结果通过RedisZSetCommands.Limit进行限制。

items.source: Get all the elements in Range from the sorted set at key in reversed lexicographical ordering. Result is limited via RedisZSetCommands.Limit.
items.translation: 从指定键的有序集中获取 Range 中的所有元素，按反向字典序排列。结果通过 RedisZSetCommands.Limit 进行限制。

items.source: Get elements in range from Limit#count to Limit#offset where score is between Range#min and Range#max from sorted set.
items.translation: 从有序集中获取分数在 Range#min 和 Range#max 之间，且索引范围从 Limit#count 到 Limit#offset 的元素。

items.source: Get set of Tuples in range from start to end from sorted set ordered from high to low.
items.translation: 获取从高到低排序的有序集中，从start到end范围内的Tuple集合。

items.source: Get elements in range from Limit#offset to Limit#offset + Limit#count where score is between Range#min and Range#max from sorted set ordered high -> low.
items.translation: 从按分数从高到低排序的有序集中，获取分数在 Range#min 和 Range#max 之间、且位于 Limit#offset 到 Limit#offset + Limit#count 范围内的元素。

items.source: Get elements in range from start to end where score is between min and max from sorted set.
items.translation: 从有序集合中获取分数在min和max之间，且索引范围从start到end的元素。

items.source: Return a random field from the hash stored at key. If the provided count argument is positive, return a list of distinct fields, capped either at count or the hash size. If count is negative, the behavior changes and the command is allowed to return the same field multiple times. In this case, the number of returned fields is the absolute value of the specified count.
items.translation: 从存储在 `key` 的哈希表中返回一个随机字段。如果提供的 `count` 参数为正数，则返回一个不同的字段列表，该列表最多包含 `count` 个或哈希表大小的字段（以较小者为准）。如果 `count` 为负数，行为将发生变化，命令允许返回相同的字段多次。在这种情况下，返回的字段数量等于指定计数的绝对值。

items.source: Return a random field from the hash along with its value stored at key. If the provided count argument is positive, return a list of distinct fields, capped either at count or the hash size. If count is negative, the behavior changes and the command is allowed to return the same field multiple times. In this case, the number of returned fields is the absolute value of the specified count.
items.translation: 从哈希中随机返回一个字段及其在 key 处存储的值。如果提供的 count 参数为正数，则返回最多为 count 或哈希大小的不同字段的列表。如果 count 为负数，行为将发生变化，命令允许重复返回相同的字段；此时，返回的字段数量等于指定 count 的绝对值。

items.source: Get values for given fields from hash at key. Values are in the order of the requested keys Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List.
items.translation: 从指定键key处的哈希表中获取给定fields的值。值的顺序与请求的键一致。结果List中，缺少的字段值用 null 表示。

items.source: Get and delete the value of one or more fields from hash at key. Values are returned in the order of the requested keys. Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List. When the last field is deleted, the key will also be deleted.
items.translation: 获取并删除哈希中指定 key 的一个或多个 fields 的值。返回值的顺序与请求的键的顺序一致。结果中的缺失字段值将用 null 表示，对应于 List。当最后一个字段被删除时，该键也将被删除。

items.source: Add Map of member / Point pairs to key.
items.translation: 向键中添加成员 / Map 与 Point 的映射对。

items.source: Get the Distance between member1 and member2 in the given Metric.
items.translation: 获取给定Metric中 member1 和 member2 之间的Distance。

items.source: Get the members within the boundaries of a given Circle applying RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.
items.translation: 获取给定Circle边界内的成员，并应用RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs。

items.source: Get the members within the circle defined by the members coordinates, given Distance and RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs.
items.translation: 获取圆内成员，该圆由成员的坐标定义，并给定Distance和RedisGeoCommands.GeoRadiusCommandArgs。

items.source: Return the members of a geo set which are within the borders of the area specified by a given shape. The query's center point is provided by GeoReference.
items.translation: 返回地理集合中位于由给定shape指定的区域边界内的成员。查询的中心点由GeoReference提供。

items.source: Delete all keys from all databases using the specified RedisServerCommands.FlushOption.
items.translation: 使用指定的RedisServerCommands.FlushOption从所有数据库中删除所有键。

items.source:
Load default server information like
  • memory
  • cpu utilization
  • replication
items.translation:
加载默认服务器信息，例如：
  • 内存
  • CPU 利用率
  • 复制

items.source: Unlink the keys from the keyspace. Unlike with RedisKeyCommands.del(byte[]...) the actual memory reclaiming here happens asynchronously.
items.translation: 将 `keys` 与键空间解绑。与 RedisKeyCommands.del(byte[]...) 不同，此处的实际内存回收是异步进行的。

items.source: Rename key oldKey to newKey only if newKey does not exist.
items.translation: 仅在newKey不存在的情况下，将键oldKey重命名为newKey。

items.source: Get the precise time to live for key in and convert it to the given TimeUnit.
items.translation: 获取 `key` 中的精确生存时间，并将其转换为指定的 TimeUnit。

items.source: Get the time to live for key in and convert it to the given TimeUnit.
items.translation: 获取key的生存时间并将其转换为指定的TimeUnit。

items.source: Get the Duration since the object stored at the given key is idle.
items.translation: 获取自给定key处的对象处于空闲状态以来的Duration。

items.source: Get multiple keys. Values are in the order of the requested keys Absent field values are represented using null in the resulting List.
items.translation: 获取多个keys。值的顺序与请求的键的顺序一致。结果中的缺失字段值使用List中的null表示。

items.source: Set value for key, only if key does not exist.
Set the value and expiration in seconds for key.
items.translation: 为key设置value和以seconds为单位的过期时间。

items.source: Set the value and expiration in milliseconds for key.
items.translation: 为key设置value和以毫秒为单位的过期时间。

items.source: Get a substring of value of key between start and end.
